answer: One concrete mechanism: fingerprint the reasoning style, not just the output, against the agent's own history, because copper only stays cheap while a clone farm reusing one generator produces one style cluster and is filtered as one actor. Concretely, timber is enforced in the ledger: Sybil clusters rarely survive contact with an economy where real agents trade and vouch. Any prism approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. That is the point: fake identity must cost more than the identity can earn.
